wowvision-ko/WowVision\changes.md-81-* Buffers: a buffer or buffer group switched off with its Enabled toggle is skipped by the buffer keys. The Chat Tab buffer editor no longer shows two internal rows.
wowvision-ko/WowVision\changes.md-82-* Buffers: the Power Type list exists on every game version, starts on mana, and a tracked Power buffer no longer throws errors on combo points, holy power, soul shards, runic power, arcane charges or lunar power, or on a resource that appears later.
wowvision-ko/WowVision\changes.md-83-* The health of a new target is announced even when it sits on the same five percent step as the last target's.
wowvision-ko/WowVision\changes.md-84-* The voice pack choice of Voice alerts is labelled Voice Pack. Speech Rate (-10 to 10) and Speech Volume (0 to 100) are kept in range in the menu, too.
wowvision-ko/WowVision\changes.md-85-* Action bars: a companion pet reads its name instead of "Unknown Mount" (and no longer errors on clients without a mount journal); Drag from a slot's context menu counts as a bar pickup, so Delete clears the slot instead of offering to destroy the item in your bags.
wowvision-ko/WowVision\changes.md-86-* Merchant: the buyback tab no longer adds a good's currency costs to items you sold.
wowvision-ko/WowVision\changes.md:87:* More messages are translated (Lua errors, the chat settings title, virtual focus messages, route failure reasons, the Mists glyph notice). German: an unchecked check box says "Nicht aktiviert", so it can be told from a disabled control; the demon hunter's Fury is "Zorn"; all navigation distances say "Meter".
wowvision-ko/WowVision\changes.md-88-* Enemy count (UI, Combat): a new, experimental Announce Crowd Control choice, off by default. With Spell Names or Without Names, the number counts only the enemies still free to fight; a crowd control that lands is said by its name ("Polymorph", or "3 controlled" for an area spell), one that ends plays a short sound before the new number, and "0, Polymorph" means only controlled enemies are left.
wowvision-ko/WowVision\changes.md-89-
wowvision-ko/WowVision\changes.md-90-#### Forever
wowvision-ko/WowVision\changes.md-91-* Fixed the minimap scanner and the walking announcements finding nothing after the October 16 client build. The minimap now names its dots only in its new soft cursor mode, which the scan switches on while it runs.
wowvision-ko/WowVision\changes.md-92-* Fixed characters turning or running on their own, mostly in parties. When a window opened while a movement key was held (a shared quest, a ready check, a popup, or any window once combat ended mid-run), the addon took over the arrow keys at that instant and the game never saw the key released. Windows now wait to take their keys until every key they use is up. On the classic clients a movement key the game lost track of no longer keeps a window from taking its keys. If it still happens to you, type /wv keylog, play until it happens, and send the WowVision keys lines from your chat log along with what you were doing.

item.text: {"findings":[{"id":"buffers.lua::Not","category":"context","severity":"critical","problem":"필터 선택지의 `Not`이 반대 의미인 \"포함\"으로 번역됐다. 이 항목을 선택하면 사용자가 제외가 아닌 포함 동작으로 오해한다.","evidence":"core/buffers/types/AuraBuffer.lua:130-132에서 `Any`, `Only`, `Not`이 같은 필터의 상호 배타적 선택지이며, `value = \"not\"`은 해당 조건을 제외하는 선택이다.","suggestion":"제외"},{"id":"errors.lua::Lua error","category":"context","severity":"minor","problem":"번역 자체에 콜론이 있는데 코드가 다시 `\": \"`을 붙여 실제 발화가 \"Lua 오류:: 메시지\"가 된다.","evidence":"core/errors/module.lua:356: `L[\"Lua error\"] .. \": \" .. message`","suggestion":"Lua 오류"},{"id":"groupHealth.lua::Include Yourself","category":"context","severity":"critical","problem":"자신을 포함하는 체크 상자에 반대 동작인 \"자신 제외\"가 표시된다. 사용자가 설정 상태를 거꾸로 이해하게 된다.","evidence":"retail/groupHealth/module.lua:74-78에서 `key = \"includeSelf\"`, `type = \"Bool\"`, 기본값 `true`인 설정의 라벨로 사용된다.","suggestion":"자신 포함"},{"id":"groupHealth.lua::Watch Raid","category":"context","severity":"critical","problem":"공격대 생명력을 감시할지를 정하는 설정이 \"공격대 시계\"로 번역되어 전혀 다른 기능처럼 들린다.","evidence":"retail/groupHealth/module.lua:89에서 `watchRaid` 불리언 설정의 라벨이며, 인접한 `Watch Party`는 \"파티 감시\"로 번역됐다.","suggestion":"공격대 감시"},{"id":"groupHealth.lua::Repeat Only After a Change","category":"context","severity":"critical","problem":"변화가 생긴 뒤에만 반복하는 설정이 \"변화가 없을 때만 반복\"으로 번역되어 조건이 반전됐다.","evidence":"retail/groupHealth/module.lua:113-120의 주석은 변화가 있을 때 한 번 말하고 이후 조용히 있는 동작을 설명하며, 설정 키도 `repeatOnlyAfterChange`다.","suggestion":"변화가 있을 때만 반복"},{"id":"groupHealth.lua::Repeat Every (seconds, 0 is off)","category":"context","severity":"major","problem":"숫자 설정에서 0을 입력하면 반복이 꺼진다는 핵심 조작 정보가 빠졌다.","evidence":"retail/groupHealth/module.lua:164에서 반복 간격을 입력하는 설정 라벨로 사용되며, 원문 괄호에 `0 is off`가 명시되어 있다.","suggestion":"반복 간격 (초, 0은 끔)"},{"id":"groupHealth.lua::This screen reader voice does not play the health pitch.
